{{Quote|Towering peaks. Home to an endangered tiger.|Description}}
'''Kudik Peaks''' {{J|クディクス山岳|Kudikusu sangaku}} is a mountain location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It becomes available for placement after the completion of "Mission #012: Jagd Hunt". In "Mission #013: The Bounty", Clan Ox spawns from this location.

When [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] engages this clan, he learns that [[Remedi|Queen Remedi]] has placed a bounty on his head. In "Mission #108: Poachers", Poachers spawn from this location. Kudik Peaks is also the site of "Mission #052: Friend Trouble". It can be freed in "Mission #250: Kudik Peaks" after "Mission #015: Scouring Time" is completed.

==Missions==
*"Mission #052: Friend Trouble"
{{Quote|Arr, them mountain beasts have been coming down to the lowlands of late, and one took a bite out of me! Find me a good hunter!|Cheney, Hunter}}
*"Mission #250: Kudik Peaks"
{{Quote|A rock slide has blocked off the road to the Kudik Peaks. Looking for people to help clear it off.|Jagark, Mountain Patrol}}
